subject: SW precache: please include the assistant's markdown renderer chunks when precaching lands
body:
sw.ts still has injectManifest { injectionPoint: undefined }, so there is no precache to add to yet.

When you turn precaching on: the tutor's markdown renderer loads on demand through dynamic import('streamdown'), import('@streamdown/math') and import('@streamdown/code'). The manifest keys are those node_modules entries plus their shiki/katex/micromark dependency chunks.

Please include them in globPatterns, or precache the dynamic-import closure of src/assistant/Markdown.tsx. Then a chat opened offline renders markdown instead of plain text.

Until then S14 is offline-safe on its own (73db893): no fetch while offline, plain text meanwhile, and a retry on the next online event.
